name: lytronix
description: Root orchestrator only. Each of server/, apps/storefront/ and apps/admin/ is a fully standalone project with its own package.json and node_modules — this is NOT an npm workspaces monorepo. These scripts just install/build/run all three from one place.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix apps/storefront && npm install --prefix apps/admin
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,storefront,admin -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix apps/storefront" "npm run dev --prefix apps/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/storefront && npm run build --prefix apps/admin
